summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-02. The volume follows the ongoing Hagun selection battles after Ikki, Stella and Shizuku build undefeated records. Ikki defeats speed specialist Renren Tomaru and Stella defeats Rai Saiyo, then Ikki discovers Ayase Ayatsuji, daughter of the Last Samurai, has been stalking him to ask for sword instruction. Ayase's need to reclaim the dojo stolen by Donrou ace Kuraudo Kurashiki drives her to sabotage Ikki before their match and use illegal Reppu Soukon traps, but Ikki defeats her while restoring her dignity. Ayase reveals Kuraudo's old duel with Kaito, and Ikki challenges Kuraudo at the ruined dojo. After enduring Sword Eater's flexible blade and superhuman Marginal Counter reflexes, Ikki wins with Kaito's Ten'i Muhou, returns the dojo to Ayase, and becomes the subject of schoolwide debate. The epilogue resolves Ayase's self-report and Kaito's awakening, confirms Nagi has discovered Ikki and Stella's secret romance, and foreshadows Shizuku's match against Toka Todo.
notes: Only character and event files were created per p1-scan instruction.
Chapter 7 is author afterword; no in-world character/event extraction was added from it.
Toka Todo is included as a foreshadowed character because she is named as Shizuku's next opponent and Hagun's strongest student, though she does not appear directly in-scene.
